rules.explanation: No mapping specification the study pins maps this concept, so the data collected for it has no standard representation.
rules.remediation: Pin a mapping specification that maps the concept, or accept the gap with a Responsibility attestation.

citation.document: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model Implementation Guide v3.4

rules.explanation: The item's unit has no conformant representation: original and standardised results need a controlled-terminology unit term and a conversion into the standard unit.
rules.remediation: Collect the result in a unit the mapping converts, or add the unit's term and conversion to the mapping specification.

citation.document: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model v2.0

rules.explanation: A variable the mapping writes has a type that cannot hold the value the mapping writes to it.
rules.remediation: Map the value to a variable of the right type (Char or Num).

rules.explanation: The item's codes cannot be decoded as the mapping decodes them: the item records a different codelist or terminology version.
rules.remediation: Bind the item to the codelist and terminology version the mapping decodes with.

citation.document: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model Implementation Guide v3.4

rules.explanation: A value the mapping assigns is not one of the values the standard lists for its variable.
rules.remediation: Assign one of the values the standard lists.

citation.document: FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

rules.explanation: A value the mapping assigns is longer than a character variable of a submission dataset holds (200 bytes).
The item has no path to an endpoint, estimand, safety rule or operational need.
rules.remediation: Link the item, its collection specification or an activity that collects it to the need it serves, or remove it.

rules.explanation: A value the mapping writes is not a term of the codelist its variable takes values from, in the terminology versions the mapping specification uses. The codelist may be extensible.
rules.remediation: Use a term of the codelist, or confirm the value is a permitted extension and record why.
